journal_entries_posted_fields_chk.name: journal_entries_posted_fields_chk
journal_entries_posted_fields_chk.value: "journal_entries"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or ("journal_entries"."doc_no" is not null and "journal_entries"."period_id" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_by" is not null)

journal_entries_source_all_or_none_chk.name: journal_entries_source_all_or_none_chk
journal_entries_source_all_or_none_chk.value: ("journal_entries"."source_type" is null) = ("journal_entries"."source_id" is null) and ("journal_entries"."source_type" is null) = ("journal_entries"."source_event" is null)

journal_entries_cancel_fields_chk.name: journal_entries_cancel_fields_chk
journal_entries_cancel_fields_chk.value: "journal_entries"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("journal_entries"."cancelled_at" is not null and "journal_entries"."reason" is not null)

bank_reconciliations_final_fields_chk.name: bank_reconciliations_final_fields_chk
bank_reconciliations_final_fields_chk.value: "bank_reconciliations"."status" <> 'final' or ("bank_reconciliations"."doc_no" is not null and "bank_reconciliations"."finalized_at" is not null and "bank_reconciliations"."finalized_by" is not null and "bank_reconciliations"."book_balance_end" is not null)

budgets_approved_fields_chk.name: budgets_approved_fields_chk
budgets_approved_fields_chk.value: "budgets"."status" <> 'approved' or ("budgets"."doc_no" is not null and "budgets"."approved_at" is not null and "budgets"."approved_by" is not null)

cash_transactions_party_chk.name: cash_transactions_party_chk
cash_transactions_party_chk.value:
("cash_transactions"."type" = 'transfer' AND "cash_transactions"."counterpart_bank_account_id" is not null AND "cash_transactions"."contra_account_id" is null)
        OR ("cash_transactions"."type" in ('receipt', 'disbursement') AND "cash_transactions"."contra_account_id" is not null AND "cash_transactions"."counterpart_bank_account_id" is null)

cash_transactions_posted_fields_chk.name: cash_transactions_posted_fields_chk
cash_transactions_posted_fields_chk.value: "cash_transactions"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or ("cash_transactions"."doc_no" is not null and "cash_transactions"."journal_entry_id" is not null)

approval_workflow_steps_approver_chk.name: approval_workflow_steps_approver_chk
approval_workflow_steps_approver_chk.value: ("approval_workflow_steps"."approver_role_id" is not null) <> ("approval_workflow_steps"."approver_user_id" is not null)

approval_workflows_amount_chk.name: approval_workflows_amount_chk
approval_workflows_amount_chk.value: "approval_workflows"."min_amount" is null or "approval_workflows"."max_amount" is null or "approval_workflows"."min_amount" <= "approval_workflows"."max_amount"

stock_documents_warehouse_chk.name: stock_documents_warehouse_chk
stock_documents_warehouse_chk.value:
("stock_documents"."type" = 'receipt' and "stock_documents"."to_warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_documents"."from_warehouse_id" is null)
        or ("stock_documents"."type" = 'issue' and "stock_documents"."from_warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_documents"."to_warehouse_id" is null)
        or ("stock_documents"."type" = 'transfer' and "stock_documents"."from_warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_documents"."to_warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_documents"."from_warehouse_id" <> "stock_documents"."to_warehouse_id")
        or ("stock_documents"."type" in ('adjustment', 'opname') and "stock_documents"."from_warehouse_id" is not null and "stock_documents"."to_warehouse_id" is null)

purchase_orders_docno_chk.name: purchase_orders_docno_chk
purchase_orders_docno_chk.value: ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'posted' and "purchase_orders"."doc_no" is not null) or ("purchase_orders"."status" <> 'posted' and "purchase_orders"."doc_no" is null)

purchase_orders_cancel_chk.name: purchase_orders_cancel_chk
purchase_orders_cancel_chk.value: "purchase_orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "purchase_orders"."reason" is not null)

ap_payments_docno_chk.name: ap_payments_docno_chk
ap_payments_docno_chk.value: ("ap_payments"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') and "ap_payments"."doc_no" is null) or ("ap_payments"."status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and "ap_payments"."doc_no" is not null)

ap_payments_posted_chk.name: ap_payments_posted_chk
ap_payments_posted_chk.value: "ap_payments"."status" <> 'posted' or ("ap_payments"."exchange_rate" is not null and "ap_payments"."exchange_rate" > 0 and "ap_payments"."amount_base" > 0 and "ap_payments"."journal_entry_id" is not null)

ap_payments_cancel_chk.name: ap_payments_cancel_chk
ap_payments_cancel_chk.value: "ap_payments"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("ap_payments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "ap_payments"."reason" is not null)

ap_payments_reverse_chk.name: ap_payments_reverse_chk
ap_payments_reverse_chk.value: "ap_payments"."status" <> 'reversed' or ("ap_payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "ap_payments"."reason" is not null)

supplier_invoices_docno_chk.name: supplier_invoices_docno_chk
supplier_invoices_docno_chk.value: ("supplier_invoices"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') and "supplier_invoices"."doc_no" is null) or ("supplier_invoices"."status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and "supplier_invoices"."doc_no" is not null)

supplier_invoices_posted_chk.name: supplier_invoices_posted_chk
supplier_invoices_posted_chk.value: "supplier_invoices"."status" <> 'posted' or ("supplier_invoices"."exchange_rate" is not null and "supplier_invoices"."exchange_rate" > 0 and "supplier_invoices"."total_base" > 0 and "supplier_invoices"."journal_entry_id" is not null)

supplier_invoices_cancel_chk.name: supplier_invoices_cancel_chk
supplier_invoices_cancel_chk.value: "supplier_invoices"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("supplier_invoices"."cancelled_at" is not null and "supplier_invoices"."reason" is not null)

supplier_invoices_reverse_chk.name: supplier_invoices_reverse_chk
supplier_invoices_reverse_chk.value: "supplier_invoices"."status" <> 'reversed' or ("supplier_invoices"."reversed_at" is not null and "supplier_invoices"."reason" is not null)
